name: Linear
description: Linear is a product development system for planning, building, and tracking software. Product and engineering teams use it to manage issues, projects, roadmaps, cycles, and the day-to-day work behind releases.
agentUseSummary: Connect a Linear workspace once, then select which agents may find and read work, prepare changes, create or update issues, and post comments under Safe or Dangerous policy.

capabilities.label: View teams
capabilities.description: List a bounded set of teams visible to the connected user.

capabilities.label: Find and read issues
capabilities.description: Find bounded issues and read one issue with bounded comments.

capabilities.label: View projects
capabilities.description: List bounded projects visible to the connected user.

capabilities.label: Prepare changes
capabilities.description: Prepare exact issue changes locally without changing Linear.

capabilities.label: Create and update issues
capabilities.description: Create one issue or update bounded fields on one explicit issue.

capabilities.label: Post comments
capabilities.description: Post one bounded comment on one explicit issue.

allowed.label: List teams
allowed.description: List bounded teams visible to the connection.

allowed.label: Read an issue
allowed.description: Read one issue and bounded comments.

allowed.label: Prepare a change
allowed.description: Prepare and hash one issue create or update locally.

approvalRequired.label: Create an issue
approvalRequired.description: Create one issue in an explicit team; Safe mode requires matching approval.

approvalRequired.label: Update an issue
approvalRequired.description: Update bounded fields on one explicit issue; Safe mode requires matching approval.

approvalRequired.label: Post a comment
approvalRequired.description: Post one bounded comment on one explicit issue; Safe mode requires matching approval.

blocked.label: Administer Linear
blocked.description: Workspace, member, team, OAuth-app, webhook, and billing administration are outside V1.

blocked.label: Delete or archive work
blocked.description: Deleting, archiving, restoring, or bulk-changing Linear work is outside V1.

blocked.label: Run arbitrary GraphQL
blocked.description: Raw GraphQL documents, introspection, unbounded traversal, and arbitrary mutations are never exposed to agents.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Bounded reads and local drafts run directly; each Linear write requires matching approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: Every selected Linear operation supported by this connector runs without Relay per-action approval; connection ownership, Linear-granted access, request bounds, audits, redaction, and provider limits still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts eight typed Linear tools and attaches the authorized workspace token server-side without exposing it to the agent.
Railway mounts eight typed Linear tools and attaches the authorized workspace token server-side without exposing it to the agent.

providerSetup.blocker: Relay Console's public Linear OAuth application, production callback, read/write scopes, client credentials, and a fresh production authorization have not been configured and verified.
providerSetup.nextAction: Create a public Linear OAuth application, register https://api.relayconsole.work/api/v1/marketplace/oauth/linear/callback, configure read and write scopes, add LINEAR_CLIENT_ID and LINEAR_CLIENT_SECRET to Railway, then verify state, PKCE, user and workspace binding, refresh rotation, bounded reads, Safe writes, Dangerous writes, revocation, disconnect, and post-disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: Linear documents public OAuth, comma-separated read/write scopes, user actor authorization, PKCE S256, 24-hour access tokens, rotating refresh tokens with a retry grace period, bearer API requests, and token revocation.

Linear documents its GraphQL endpoint, OAuth bearer authentication, viewer and team queries, issue reads, issue creation, and issue updates, and requires callers to inspect GraphQL errors even on HTTP 200.
Linear documents typed model queries and mutations, projects, comments, explicit pagination, and bounded first-page fetching.
Linear documents OAuth request and complexity limits, endpoint-specific limits, bounded pagination guidance, and RATELIMITED GraphQL errors.
Linear documents public OAuth application manifests, multiple HTTPS redirect URIs, authorization-code grants, and reproducible application configuration.
